Maket has launched Custom Materials, a feature that lets users design their own floors and walls for the homes they plan in Maket.

Users can describe a material, such as an aged checkered stone tile, or upload an image of one, and then use it across their floor plans.

The rooms
posts.quoted: Generate floor and wall textures from text or an image. Light oak, terracotta tile, or checkerboard marble? Try it out in your space and see what feels right. Your next room refresh starts in Maket.
